scope: Two single-task C1 routed Go/Aider diagnostics; performance measurement and model promotion are outside scope.

route.historical_path_difference: Historical Go jobs used direct backend; these jobs use the existing authenticated router under host policy. No matched performance comparison.

controls.cache_policy: preserved; uncontrolled warm state; no reset

oracle.preparation: offline; independently requalify six starter/reference oracles, no build/pull/retag
oracle.receipt_custody: Pre-dispatch receipt bytes retained in inputs/prepared-oracle-<cap>.json; native job preparation paths may be rewritten by managed worker requalification. Both retained separately.

continuation_policy.ordinary_quality_miss: retain and proceed to next preplanned diagnostic
continuation_policy.infrastructure_identity_oom_admission_fa: stop; no rollback or model/route modification

custody.per_job: fresh exact managed engine and route checks; owned worker terminal/exit and fresh engine running/waiting zero before next job
custody.safety_samples: bounded read-only metrics and managed status; no isolated throughput/counter attribution claims because live user traffic may coexist

classification.generation_limit: finish length classified separately with usage and cap_reached
classification.visible_tokens: unknown unless independently available; completion minus reasoning is derived non_reasoning
